# Bundled rendering dependency

Three.js 0.180.0, MIT license. Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

The existing installed release's three.module.min.js and three.core.min.js are bundled unchanged for this game's renderer. Runtime imports stay on this site; no CDN or remote rendering service is required. See THREE-LICENSE.txt for the complete copyright and license notice. Original Code Quest scene, geometry, procedural textures, animation and game logic are separate from this third-party engine.
